state.question: Assess Juniper Chips's reported inventory ageing. I need the following measured result: The September share of finished chips older than 180 days, compared with June on a unit basis.
state.conclusion: Juniper reported lower warehouse inventory at quarter-end.
state.gap: The September share of finished chips older than 180 days, compared with June on a unit basis.

candidates.abstract: Our reporting desk follows Juniper Chips, drawing on an independent correspondent's account of the September share of finished chips older than 180 days, compared with June on a unit basis.

candidates.abstract: An edited digest of Theo Park's Dispatch's dispatch on Juniper Chips, retaining its reported comparison and attribution.
